name: prefix-filtered-8
about: The triangulation of prefix-8 with another face t0; the example of proofs/algorithm/algorithm.md. "extension" is the only state that is not good, and the only state with the corner 1 in the third face. That choice passes both tests of the search: the opposite side 67 closes no cycle, and H+ without the edge chosen is connected. "extension" is also the only state with the corners "prefix" in the first two faces. These pass the test of the manuscript, as H+ without the two edges is connected, but not that of the note: the opposite sides 01 and 14 join the roots 0 and 4.
